title: Jetstar Return for Free to Japan and South Korea
body:
Deal: Jetstar Return for Free to Japan and South Korea

[node modules] between May 2027 and June 2027
No thanks. You do you and me do me.
[Manazuru] May isn't the typical typhoon season (last May typhoon was in 2003). May is an excellent shoulder season month, and has great weather and day light hours. Late May or June, might experience a very rare typhoon, but it's far more common in August, September and October.
Same goes for Korea.
[illusion99] I’ll take tourist season anytime over having to work here
[NZbargainerbahaha] @illusion99: its not typhoon season at all i have been there in 1st week of may its one of the most pleasant weather in Japan not too cold and not too hot Lesser tourist because the cherry blossoms are over so a bit cheaper accomodations
[Nomad2233] That’s summer in Japan and June is pretty humid
[PVA] Not too bad at that time July Sept is really bad for humidity.
[jeffreytam] I wonder why Jetstar always have their major promotions in such a short notice 😂
[DingoBilly] Many places have 1 day frenzies and similar, it's not a particularly unique thing to Jetstar.
[BangkokBreakfast] Yes, just no pricing yet untill it goes live.
[jeffreytam] Especially when traveling to Japan 🤣 Even not enough with just carry-on
[tightm8] Saving a couple of hundred on a trip that will set you back thousands is generally not my advice but I was once 20-something and would cheap out $10 on a flight to suffer 8 hour waits, so I guess there's a market :)
[DingoBilly] It's probably $500-$1000 or so savings.
That's a decent saving, and not sure what you mean but the flight is a pretty insignificant part of the trip. Spending hundreds more to achieve the same outcome doesn't make a lot of sense.
[mr_asstight] Best thing about Korea and Japan is no multiculturalism and diversity
